answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Sponsored film director fellowship with film institute attestation. It requires a fellowship the institute renews after production audits, so the dawn of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The jade is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The ripple is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
